scope: 20 historically exposed Qwen clips; descriptive observations only
event_time_semantics: available_audio_s = available_samples / 16000; this is available-audio time, not a word endpoint
decoder_frame_semantics: start_frame/end_frame are decoder coordinates on its original 10 ms grid; no reference word endpoints are available
repeat_semantics: repeated_activation_events counts every activation after the first in a clip; no deduplication or suppression
matching_repeat_semantics: positive_repeated_matching_events sums max(matching activations minus one, zero) per positive clip
positive_hit_semantics: at least one activation of the declared keyword; wrong-keyword activations remain separate events
